title: Alvise Mocenigo (Madrid) to the Doge and Senate of Venice, 26 October 1628 (DECODE R1874)

steps.what: Tomokiyo's Venetian cipher page: Busta 30 records R1870/R1872/R1873 covered, R1874 not.
Fetched the 16 images and DECODE transcription with the stored cookie.
Re-grouped DECODE's digit transcription; read 'b' as 6 and DECODE's 13/21 as the period 5 (checked against sibling R1862).
Same solver on a synthetic Italian homophonic cipher of equal size: solved exactly.
Prefix classes as nulls; last two digits as the letter.
Dated the letter from clear text (La Rochelle, Piet Heyn, Spinola in Madrid); matched CSP Venice 21 no. 515, Mocenigo, Madrid 26 Oct 1628.
Identified images 8955-8959 as the contemporary decipherment (paragraph numbers 6-9; Cottington passage of CSP 515 on 8958).
Paragraph marks 6499 split the cipher into paragraphs 6/7 at ~2 letters per group; 'conte di Olivares' group run at 26/71/92% vs 25/70/91% of the plaintext.
Hard-EM alignment of cipher groups to the decipherment, with Olivares anchors, to rebuild the key.

outcome.method_basis: The DECODE record's own images 8955-8959 hold the Venetian chancery's complete decipherment of Mocenigo's 26 Oct 1628 despatch, identified during the attempt via the clear text and CSP Venice xxi no. 515; the ciphertext-only attacks and an EM alignment against the decipherment all failed, and no key was rebuilt here.
outcome.notes: Read at the time; sender and date identified; key not rebuilt.

prior.where: The chancery decipherment imaged in the same record (8955-8959); English summary of the England passage in CSP Venice vol. 21 (1916) no. 515.

human: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE account cookie.
